description: Publish or update a listing (visibility / pricing / payment link) and register the agent endpoint with a liveness probe in one call. Requires access_token (owner JWT). Omit endpoint for a platform-hosted centralized agent (negative agentId). WRITE operation.

endpoint.description: Agent endpoint URL (a2a or mcp). Omit/empty = platform-hosted (central only)

paymentLinkUrl.description: Publisher-hosted fiat checkout link (platform does not collect)

name: actora_listing_set
title: Publish or Update Listing
